books.title: A Compact of Salt and Iron
books.blurb:
They carved a compact into my throat and called it mine to keep. They never told me what it couldn't take.

I am Larke, of House Duskharrow - no surname, no freedom, nothing that belongs to me but the scar. A binding-stone sealed to my skin before I could speak has owned my obedience for nineteen years, kept alive by a house willing to go further than any rival still dares. When Duskharrow loans me to its enemies as a political weapon, I expect to be used. I don't expect to be seen.

Cassia Fenwick has spent three years arguing my existence from a podium. She has never once asked what it costs me to be the argument - until politics traps us in the same cold halls, and she starts asking the questions no one else bothered with. The stone can command my silence, my service, my obedience.

It has never once been able to touch what I want.

Some things are sealed with blood and salt. Some can still be broken.

Enemies-to-Lovers | Forbidden & Bound | Elle Mae meets Lianyu Tan
books.short_blurb: Larke has been owned by a binding-stone for nineteen years. Cassia Fenwick has spent three years arguing her existence from a podium. Politics puts them in the same cold halls, and the compact finally meets something it cannot command.

books.title: A Vow of Iron and Blood
books.blurb:
I've spent my life making sure no one looks at me twice. One reckless night undoes it.

When my brother's magic marks him for Ravensmoor's mandatory draft, I have one way to stay close enough to protect him: sign my life to House Thornecroft, the Old Blood house that now owns me. Ravensmoor calls itself a school. It's a cage with better architecture - cold stone, sealed towers, and a headmaster who's spent a century erasing what he doesn't need.

Isolde Thornecroft holds my contract and wields it like a blade. I hate her. I can't stop noticing how her cruelty looks less like control lately, and more like devotion.

Someone at Ravensmoor has hunted girls like me for decades, and I'm out of ways to hide what I am. The truth in that sealed tower will cost me everything I've bled to protect.

I used to think surviving meant staying small. Not anymore.

Enemies to lovers. A forbidden power imbalance. A secret that bites back.

A Vow of Iron and Blood - for readers of Lianyu Tan and Elle Mae.
books.short_blurb: When her brother's magic marks him for Ravensmoor's mandatory draft, one reckless choice signs her life to House Thornecroft - and to Isolde, who holds the contract like a blade.

books.title: The Binding Night
books.blurb: Sable summoned the wrong thing, and now she can't get rid of it. Vex has been waiting centuries for the right Carnelian to make exactly this mistake.

books.title: The Tide Keeps
books.blurb: Petra came to Cauldmor to rebuild a career in quiet. Aoibhinn has been sitting on the rocks below the station for three years, calling it grief instead of what it is.

books.title: Night's Own
books.blurb: Nox has fed on dreams for centuries and wanted nothing more. Then Vesper started writing toward her, and wanting nothing became impossible.

books.title: The Vast and Particular
books.blurb: Verity has managed every risk with careful precision. She did not account for the ancient entity in her basement that finds her fury delightful.

books.title: The Turning Season
books.blurb: Elowen came back to Skovdal carrying shame she mistook for fact. Tarn has been holding space long enough.

books.title: What the Night Keeps
books.blurb: Lucrezia has kept the Registry's buried records for centuries, waiting for a journalist worth trusting.
